facts.fact: AUDA-NEPAD, the African Union's development agency, launched on 24 July 2026 at the STC-TTIM ministerial segment in Abidjan its Programme for African Developing Island Economies, which Guinea-Bissau joins with six other island states; digital transformation is one of its six pillars, and the programme runs on a 2026-2031 roadmap.
